highlights: Published bar packages for 50, 100 and 250 guests
Typically one bartender for every 50–75 guests
Every listed package includes a fridge, ice and glassware
Cash bar packages run for unlimited hours
Festival bars for music festivals, fairs and galas

howItWorks.title: Check your date
howItWorks.text: Use the availability form on their website to ask whether your event date is free, or request a quote online.

howItWorks.title: Shape the package
howItWorks.text: Packages vary with the date, location and requirements of each event, so the team invites you to talk it through with them. If you are unsure which package suits, they will compare the options for you.

howItWorks.title: Secure the booking
howItWorks.text: A non-refundable deposit is taken when you book.

howItWorks.title: Setup on the day
howItWorks.text: The team usually begins setting up two to three hours before the event starts, depending on how complex the setup is.

goodToKnow.text: Published package prices are ex VAT. Packages are subject to availability and can vary with the date, location and requirements of the event, and delivery conditions or additional timings may affect the final service.

Delivery and setup charges are included within a certain radius; venues further afield may incur additional fees. For dry hire, setup and delivery are discussed with you, and the cost varies with date, time and location.
Dry hire is typically booked for a minimum of one day. Your drinks need to be on site before the team arrives, and the bar area should be clear and accessible for setup.
If cash bar takings fall short of the agreed minimum, the host may be required to cover the difference; the details can be tailored in the event contract.
Bartenders are trained to serve alcohol responsibly and to monitor consumption.
Once an event-management plan is finalised, changes are accommodated where possible, though some may incur additional costs.

faqs.a: The deposit paid at booking is non-refundable. Cancellations made within 30 days of the event may be subject to a cancellation fee, which is set out in the booking confirmation.

faqs.q: What if our event runs longer than planned?
faqs.a: They say they are flexible and can extend service times. Additional charges may apply for the extra hours, and these can be discussed in advance.

faqs.q: Can we choose the drinks on an all-inclusive package?
faqs.a: Yes. They work with you on the selection, which can include beers, wines, spirits and speciality cocktails tailored to the theme of the event.

faqs.q: Can the bar match our event's theme?
faqs.a: Their main focus is the drinks and the service, but they can coordinate with event decorators so that the bar decor matches your theme as part of a customised package.

faqs.q: Can we give guests some free drinks before switching to a cash bar?
faqs.a: Yes. A cash bar can be combined with a token or voucher system, with the host covering a set number of drinks before guests start paying for their own.

faqs.q: What happens if the weather turns?
faqs.a: For events they manage, they keep contingency plans in place, including possible indoor alternatives or protective coverings, so the event can carry on.

faqs.q: Will they manage an event at the venue we have chosen?
faqs.a: Yes. They have preferred venues they work with often, but say their team can manage events at any location the client chooses.

faqs.q: How are emergencies handled on the day?
faqs.a: They say they have comprehensive emergency procedures and trained staff ready to respond, to keep everyone attending safe.

serviceDetails.name: All-Inclusive Bar Hire
serviceDetails.more: Their website lists three all-inclusive packages, priced ex VAT: 50 guests for 4 hours at £1495, with two bar staff and a 5ft bar; 100 guests for 4 hours at £2995, with four staff and a 15ft bar; and 250 guests for 5 hours at £6995, with six staff, a 30ft bar and two fridges. Each covers beer, wine and spirits, garnishes and consumables, plus a fridge, ice and glassware.

serviceDetails.name: Dry Hire
serviceDetails.more: Listed dry hire packages, priced ex VAT, are £695 for 50 guests over 4 hours (two bar staff and a 5ft bar) and £1395 for 100 guests over 4 hours (four staff and a 15ft bar), each with a fridge, ice and glassware. A 250-guest, 5-hour option is listed at £2395 with six staff, a 30ft bar and two fridges. The bar setup can be customised to suit the theme and size of the event.

serviceDetails.name: Cash Bar Hire
serviceDetails.more: Listed cash bar packages run for unlimited hours and are priced ex VAT: £495 for 50 guests (two bar staff and a 5ft bar), £895 for 100 guests (four staff and a 15ft bar) and £1495 for 250 guests (six staff, a 30ft bar and two fridges). Each includes a fully customisable bar menu, garnishes and consumables, and a fridge, ice and glassware.

serviceDetails.name: Pop-Up and Branded Bars
serviceDetails.more: Listed bar sizes are 5ft, 10ft, 15ft, 35ft and a 40ft island, with pop-up bars advertised 'From £295'. Corporate clients can also have branded merchandise and custom cocktail menus designed around their brand, with mixologists working with premium spirits.

serviceDetails.name: Event Management
serviceDetails.more: Clients share their budget and key wishes, and the team takes care of the suppliers and special touches. They work closely with clients throughout the planning, coordinate directly with other vendors and are on site on the day to manage logistics from start to finish.

serviceDetails.name: Staff and Glass Hire
serviceDetails.more: Glass hire is priced per glass on their website: 12oz £0.60, Margarita £0.80, Flute £0.60, Wine £0.60, Gin Bowl £0.80, Martini £0.75, Shot £0.50, 1/2 Pint £0.50, Pint £0.50 and Whisky £0.65.

notes: All pages were fetched on 27 October 2026. The package, FAQ and glass-hire content was last modified in May 2024, so prices and package contents should be confirmed with the business. The Dry Hire page labels its 250-guest package 'All Inclusive', and its package descriptions mention a 10ft bar (100 guests) and a 20ft bar (250 guests) while the itemised lists say 15FT and 30FT; serviceDetails follow the itemised lists. The setup timing (two to three hours before the event) and the delivery radius are stated in the Dry Hire FAQ; the radius itself is not given. The business does not publish a single step-by-step booking guide, so howItWorks is assembled from its own availability form, package notes, deposit FAQ and setup FAQ. Both Staff Hire pages are empty, so no staff roles, rates or minimum hours could be added. An unlinked 'Who We Are' page (/about/) mentions a pool of over 100 event professionals; it is not in the site navigation and the site also serves theme demo pages (/services/, /events/, /reviews/, /about-us/ with placeholder text and a US placeholder phone number), so it was not used. No reviews, ratings or awards were used.
